items.html: And being clothed in these four Mochin, they again became only three. For the two Mochin called Hochma and Bina, the inheritance of Aba and Ima, entered: Hochma in the Netzah of Ima, and Bina in the Hod of Ima. And the two hidden coronets were clothed, both of them together, in the Yesod of Bina. Having been bounded within this vessel, they became united and were made into a single brain alone, called Daat, comprising the two coronets called Hesed and Gevura, as above.
